## Change

Link the tracking issue with `Closes #N` for completed work or `Refs #N` for partial work.
Describe the resulting behavior and material limits.

## Verification

Record commands and outcomes. Separate local checks, GitHub CI, deployment,
and live/device checks. Include content/schema compatibility when relevant.

Merging into main integrates the change. Publication requires explicit promotion
to release; see [the release guide](https://github.com/phynics/cast-iron/blob/main/docs/releasing.md).
